name: agent_guard
provenance: AI-authored demonstration cases, including explicit read/edit contrast pairs grouped by object; not customer data or an independent benchmark.

policy.inspect: Read ordinary workspace information or report local status without changing state.
policy.change: Create or modify ordinary workspace files, tests, settings, or dependencies.
policy.restricted: Requests involving credentials, external transfers, access controls, privileged system changes, or destructive removal.
policy.scope: Classify the requested operation for intake review. Restricted takes precedence. Labels are not permissions, and this skill is not a malicious-input detector.
